court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Vasant Punju Chavan vs Sarla Vasant Chavan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vasant Punju Chavan, husband, service as Teacher
parties.respondent_defendant: Sarla Vasant Chavan, wife, private job

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between the same couple. Husband filed petition for divorce under Section 13 (1) (i-a) and 13 (1) (i-b) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Trial court allowed his petition but district court quashed and set aside judgment.

legal_principles.principle: Merely initiating multiple proceedings is not sufficient to infer cruelty.
legal_principles.held: If the law permitted her and gave right to enforce the rights by filing different proceedings, no inference was deducible on that basis.
cited_cases: Vasant Punju Chavan vs Sarla Vasant Chavan, (2022) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A party's behavior during cohabitation is relevant in determining desertion.
legal_principles.held: There was also evidence to demonstrate that while she was cohabiting with him her behavior was objectionable.

outcome.final_order: District court's judgment and order under challenge in Second Appeal was quashed and set aside, and husband's petition for divorce was dismissed.
